meta.title: Crew
meta.description: The crew as a DSH plugin: sidebar entry, panel for crews, roles, default and project, the routes /api/pmh/crew, and the host wiring of adapter, tools and booking. Stored per account in PostgreSQL, with the file as fallback. English first, German second.
